# Tokei comparison baseline

`languages.json` comes from the official [Tokei v12.1.2 tag](https://github.com/XAMPPRocky/tokei/blob/v12.1.2/languages.json). It contains 226 language definitions. SHA-256: `052E1E34CE726903EF8C2067D40BFA6A1DC992E20AE239D904DCC319ED631092`.

The port uses the newer v15.0.0 language table. This older snapshot is kept only to select definitions that are exactly the same in both versions when comparing the port with the available v12.1.2 executable. The official executable itself is not bundled here.

Upstream offers this data under Apache-2.0 OR MIT.
